messages:
oliver (new-hire): Hi team, Oliver here. First on-call rotation this week. Quick list: runbook perms, test page to phone, and a short walkthrough of the 'sev assign' criteria?
rachel (oncall-lead): Welcome! Runbooks in Confluence > Reliability > Oncall Runbooks. If you hit a permissions error tell me your SSO. OpsGenie should send push+SMS. Sev criteria in runbook section 'Severity Guide' (short: Sev1 = widespread customer impact; Sev2 = partial but impacting SLA; Sev3 = internal/non-customer).
oliver (new-hire): My SSO is oliver@redwood.com. Also, test page shows "ack failed" in OpsGenie.
tariq (sre): OpsGenie sometimes shows ack failed when app background refresh is off. Check mobile settings and re-login. I sent a re-invite.
ops-bot: NOTE: Oncall orientation recording: https://drive/reliability/oncall-intro.mp4.
oliver (new-hire): Re-login fixed ack. One last: where do I find the quick command snippets for debugging the model-serving pool?
rachel (oncall-lead): See runbook > Debugging > Model pool checks. Snippets include: `curl /health`, `redis-cli info`, `kubectl get pods -n model-serving`. If you need elevated creds ping @tariq.
oliver (new-hire): Got it. Thanks all — looking forward to the shadow shift.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Oliver shadow with Rachel 1 2026-04-02 02:00-10:00 UTC."
